identityLocked.title: Identity Locked
identityLocked.description: True once this conversation is pinned to a verified email.

message.title: Message
message.description: Summary of the caller's open cases, or that they have none - safe to relay to the customer as-is.

openCaseCount.title: Open Case Count
openCaseCount.description: Number of the caller's open cases. Zero means they have none.

verified.title: Verified
verified.description: True if the email and identifier matched the same customer. False means nothing was looked up.

verifiedEmail.title: Verified Email
verifiedEmail.description: The email that was verified. Empty when verification failed.
